topic: Harmful Effects of Loud Sounds and Light
key_concepts: Repeated exposure to loud sounds can cause hearing loss
Airplane noise, rock concerts, and loud machines are sources of harmful sound
Sounds are safe below a certain decibel level
Sounds can damage ears from a certain decibel level
Loudness and exposure time affect hearing damage
Covering ears with materials can reduce sound loudness
Some materials reduce sound better than others
The sun emits UVA, UVB, and UVC rays
UVA and UVB rays reach the skin
Prolonged sun exposure can harm health
UV rays are highest at a certain time of day
